scope: Actual retained SVC/PendSV/SysTick runtime with six disjoint PSP stacks: copied messages, timeout/abort, condition timeout/reacquisition and close/reap/restart.
limits: Emulator observations only; no physical board, WCET, SMP, asynchronous task kill, peripheral DMA quiescence, or exhaustive execution claim.
The context image includes FP save/restore instructions; this experiment does not exercise floating-point payload registers.
